title: Biogas Digesters for Dairy Cooperatives — Mbarara & Ntungamo
summary: Installation of community-scale biogas digesters at 6 dairy cooperative sites in Mbarara and Ntungamo Districts to supply cooking and lighting energy from cattle waste.
description: This project targets dairy cooperatives in the Ankole region of Western Uganda where high cattle density creates significant organic waste. Fixed-dome biogas digesters were installed at 6 cooperative collection points, converting cattle waste into biogas for cooking and electricity generation. Each digester serves 25–40 households in adjacent farmer communities. Slurry from the digesters is distributed as high-quality fertiliser, reducing chemical fertiliser purchases. Technical management was transferred to cooperative management committees after a 6-month capacity-building period.
locationNote: Covers Mbarara and Ntungamo Districts, Ankole sub-region
outcomes: 6 cooperative sites with biogas; 150+ households with clean cooking energy; slurry fertiliser distributed to 200+ farms; 60 tCO2e emissions avoided annually.
